text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon entering VR space, pass by horse girl.
Seeing what look like tears in eyes—stopped her instinctively.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Fault is mine for being too weak...!
To receive Byerley Turk-san's guidance,
lack ability as I am now... gh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She left.
Time to ask Byerley Turk
for more details.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
Referring to that weakling who fled
while I oversaw training?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Evidently, the regimen was far harder
than she anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...She chose to retreat.
If my instruction does not suit her,
there is no need to force it.
choice_data_list: You shouldn't give up until the very end

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Cheering on a support AI?
Such thought process is typical of a novice.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I have not given up.
As horse girls, they must face their weakness
in every way and remain strong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If my own student ran away, I might lose
confidence as an instructor and struggle—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I conveyed those exact thoughts
to Byerley Turk.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
What good comes from getting depressed over this?
With such weak mindset, you cannot serve
as guide for horse girls with a future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If so, all the more reason to chase her—
Perhaps sensing my lingering doubt,
Byerley Turk let out a slight smile.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Do not rush.
It merely means compatibility differs for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
And I am not the only support AI.
Find someone better suited for that student.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, I have free time.
If any student seeks strength,
they are always welcome.
choice_data_list: Eager to get back to work already, I see

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
A single day sooner, one more student...
These horse girls must become strong.
